title: Estimate aboveground biomass using Chave et al. (2014) — chave_biomass
text: Applies height-inclusive pantropical equation AGB = 0.0673 * (rho * D^2 * H)^0.976. Basic wood density selected automatically FRTC (2025) five FRTC species whose recommended biomass equations use density, GWDD v2.2 exact infraspecific, binomial, genus level. GWDD model-derived trunk density (wsg_est_trunk) used rather raw mean.
